sentences.en: Our calculations show that the rocket is off its course.
sentences.zh: 我们的计算显示火箭偏离了轨道。

sentences.en: The astronauts went up to the moon in a rocket.
sentences.zh: 宇航员乘坐火箭登上了月球。

sentences.en: The rocket landed sufficiently gently to avoid breaking its instruments.
sentences.zh: 火箭着陆时非常平稳，没有损坏仪器。

senses.zh: 飞驰，飞快地移动；迅速增加
